messages:
maya: Quick decision needed: should the console home show a full-width onboarding banner with 3 starter cards, or a smaller inline "Starter stack" that lives inside the workspace panel? pros/cons?
tess: Full-width banner is high-visibility for new signups but noisy for returning users. we can hide it after first session.
owen: Inline stack less disruptive and feels contextually relevant. but it might be missed if the user opens a specific workspace directly.
rami: UX thoughtcards should surface runnable samples + a single-line description + estimated run time (e.g., 10s) so users know the friction.
anita: accessibility nits: cards must be keyboard focusable, have clear aria-labels, and include text equivalents for any decorative icons. also ensure banner close is reachable by keyboard.
tess: copy idea for full-width: header "Start building with Redwood" and three CTAs: "Run demo", "Import repo", "Explore templates". short and actionable.
maya: inline stack copy: just the 3 CTAs and a subtle header "Starter projects". minimal words.
owen: analytics tradeoff: full banner likely higher CTR. inline might convert better for users who landed on console intentionally.
rami: tech constraints: full banner causes layout shift on load if we wait for server flags. prefer server-side marker so we can render without jump.
anita: color/contrast: banner background must meet AA for text. card CTAs need 3:1 for icon-on-background in small sizes.
tess: localization: long languages will truncate card titles. keep them 20-30 chars.
maya: question: should "Run demo" open a modal runner inside the page, or redirect to a workspace page?
owen: modal runner is faster and keeps context; but it must be accessible (trap focus, announce start). redirect gives full tooling but higher friction.
rami: implement runner as progressive: modal by default, with an "Open full workspace" link in the modal. modal loads lightweight runtime and streams logs.
anita: SR behavior: announce "Demo started" and updates for completion. add polite live region for status messages. also make logs collapsible and navigable by keyboard.
tess: metrics: measure time-to-demo-run, demo-completion rate, and how many open full workspace after demo.
maya: rollout idea: banner for 100% new accounts for 7 days, then evaluate. inline stack as fallback for existing accounts.
owen: snooze patterns: allow "Hide for this session" and "Don't show again" (persisted in user prefs). add easy undo in settings.
rami: telemetry: events onboarding.banner.show, onboarding.card.run, onboarding.runner.complete. don't include sample payloads or keys.
anita: final a11y checklist i'll add: focus order, live region tests, keyboard shortcuts listed in help menu, contrast verificaton.
ux-bot: Figma comps uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi/onboard-banner-vs-stack (preview).
maya: great thread. i'll consolidate notes and drop a spec PR with Figma links. target review Friday.
